strings.b.help:
LingoBot na-atụgharị ozi Telegram na ozi olu n'ihe ọhụụ Even G2 gị.

1. Mepee LingoBot n'ihe ọhụụ gị ma zipu m koodu ọ gosiri: /start LB-XXXX
2. Tọọ asụsụ gị: /lang. Ihe ọhụụ gị na mkparịta ụka a ga-agbanwe ka ọ bụrụ ya, ihe niile n'asụsụ ọzọ ga-atụgharịkwa ka ọ bụrụ ya.
3. Zipụ ozi ma ọ bụ ozi olu ọ bụla ebe a.
4. Họrọ ma ọ bụ kwuo azịza n'ihe ọhụụ.
5. Na mkparịta ụka mbụ, dee @{bot} wee pịa azịza gị iji zipu ya.
6. Iji jikọọ ihe ọhụụ ahụ na akaụntụ ọzọ: /disconnect

Ọnọdụ akpaaka (enweghị izipu):
• Mkparịta ụka nkeonwe (Telegram Premium): Settings > Telegram Business > Chatbots > tinye @{bot}, họrọ mkparịta ụka, kwe ka "Reply to messages". Ozi asụsụ mba ọzọ ga-apụta n'ihe ọhụụ gị, azịza gị ga-aga dị ka gị.
• Otu: tinye m n'otu ahụ ma zipu /watch ebe ahụ. Ozi ọ bụla na asụsụ gị ọ bụghị ga-apụta n'ihe ọhụụ gị (/watch mentions: naanị ihe ndị kpọrọ gị aha na azịza ndị gbara gị). M ga-ebipụta azịza gị n'otu ahụ. /unwatch iji kwụsị.
• Soro ndị mmadụ n'otu, nke onwe: /follow ebe a, họrọ otu ahụ, mgbe ahụ onye ahụ. (N'otu n'onwe ya: /watch @aha, ma ọ bụ zaghachi ozi ya site na /watch.) Ihe ọ bụla ha bipụtara (ederede ma ọ bụ olu) ga-aga n'ihe ọhụụ gị n'asụsụ gị; zaghachi site n'olu, họrọ azịza AI, ma ọ bụ leghara ya. /unwatch @aha iji kwụsị, /watching iji hụ ihe niile ị na-ele anya.

Ndekọ olu sitere n'ihe ọhụụ:
• /notes: họrọ ebe ha ga-aga: otu gị (mepụta otu naanị gị na ya maka ndekọ nkeonwe), onye (/notes @aha; ọ ga-abụ na ọ mepeghị mkparịta ụka na m), ma ọ bụ mkparịta ụka a. N'ihe ọhụụ, họrọ "Record a voice note" n'ihuenyo Ready wee pịa iji kwụsị: a ga-ezipu ya dị ka ozi olu, yana ederede.
• Ị na-agwa onye asụsụ ọzọ okwu? /notes → 🌐 na-ahọrọ asụsụ ha na-agụ (ma ọ bụ /notes lang Spanish): ị na-ekwu n'asụsụ gị, ederede dị n'okpuru ndekọ olu ọ bụla ga-atụgharị ka ọ bụrụ nke ha.

source.b.help:
LingoBot translates Telegram messages and voice notes on your Even G2.

1. Open LingoBot on your glasses and send me the code it shows: /start LB-XXXX
2. Set your language: /lang. Your glasses and this chat switch to it, and everything in another language is translated into it.
3. Forward any message or voice note here.
4. Pick or speak a reply on the glasses.
5. In the original chat, type @{bot} and tap your reply to send it.
6. To pair the glasses with another account: /disconnect

Automatic mode (no forwarding):
• Private chats (Telegram Premium): Settings > Telegram Business > Chatbots > add @{bot}, pick the chats, allow "Reply to messages". Foreign-language messages appear on your glasses and your reply is sent as you.
• Groups: add me to the group and send /watch there. Every message not in your language appears on your glasses (/watch mentions: only mentions of you and replies to you). I post your reply in the group. /unwatch to stop.
• Follow people in a group, privately: /follow here, pick the group, then the person. (In the group itself: /watch @name, or reply to their message with /watch.) Everything they post (text or voice) reaches your glasses in your language; reply by voice, pick an AI reply, or ignore it. /unwatch @name to stop, /watching to see everything you watch.

Voice notes from the glasses:
• /notes: pick where they go: one of your groups (create a group with only me in it for private notes), a person (/notes @name; they must have opened a chat with me), or this chat. On the glasses, choose "Record a voice note" on the Ready screen and tap to stop: it is sent as a voice message, with a transcript.
• Talking with someone who speaks another language? /notes → 🌐 picks the language they read (or /notes lang Spanish): you speak in yours, and the transcript under each voice note is translated into theirs.

source.b.notesHereAgain: Voice notes from your glasses are saved here again. /notes to pick a group or a person.
source.b.notUsername5: That does not look like a @username (5+ letters). Send /notes to pick from a list.
source.b.notesNoLonger: Voice notes from your glasses will no longer be saved here.
source.b.notesHere:
Voice notes you record on your glasses will be saved here, with a transcript when available.
On the G2: Ready screen → "Record a voice note". /notes off to stop.
source.b.notesSavedWhere: Voice notes from your glasses are saved {where}.
source.b.notesTip: Tip: for a private notes chat, create a new group in Telegram, add only me (@{bot}), then send /notes here again. It shows up with 🔒 "only you".
source.b.thatIsYou: That is you: voice notes are saved here, in this chat.
source.b.thatIsMe: That is me. Send the @username of a person, or pick a group with /notes.
source.b.cannotMessage: I cannot message @{handle} yet: Telegram only lets me write to people who have opened a chat with me. Ask them to open t.me/{bot} and tap Start, then send /notes @{handle} again.
source.b.notesNowPerson: Voice notes from your glasses now go to {name} (@{handle}). /notes to change.
source.b.sendNotesUsername: Send the @username of the person who should get your voice notes.
source.b.notUsernameNotes: That does not look like a @username. Open /notes to try again.
source.b.notMember: You are not a member of that group.
source.b.botLeft: I am no longer in that group.
source.b.mentionsMe: 💬 Mentions of me & replies to me
source.b.tapPerson: Tap a person to follow them: everything they post (text or voice, any language) reaches your glasses in {lang}. Tap again to stop.
source.b.noNames: No one has posted since I joined, so I have no names to show yet. Type their @username instead.
source.b.noGroups:
I am not in any of your groups yet (or I joined before I could see messages).

Add me to the group (or remove me and add me again), then send /follow here.
source.b.followHere: Use /follow here, in our private chat, so the group does not see it.
source.b.personGone: That person is no longer listed.
source.b.sendUsernameFollow: Send the @username of the person to follow in {title} (several are fine, separated by spaces).
source.b.notUsername: That does not look like a @username. Open /follow to try again.
source.b.businessOff: LingoBot is no longer connected to your chats.
source.b.businessOn: LingoBot is now watching the chats you selected.
source.b.businessReply: To send replies automatically, turn on "Reply to messages" for LingoBot in Settings > Telegram Business > Chatbots.
source.b.businessPair: Pair your glasses to receive messages: /start LB-XXXX
source.b.voiceTooLongNamed: {name} sent a voice note longer than {max}s; it was not transcribed.
source.b.forwardSomething: Forward a text message or a voice note.
source.b.cmdNotes: Pick the group or person for your voice notes
source.g.noteRecLang:
Voice note  ›  {chat}  ·  translated to {lang}
Tap to stop and send.
source.b.notesLangLine: Each note is transcribed and translated into {lang} for them; your voice stays as it is.
source.b.notesLangNone: Not translated. Tap 🌐 if they read another language.
source.b.notesLangPick:
Which language does {chat} read? You keep speaking your language: the transcript under each voice note is translated into theirs.
Any language works here (type /notes lang <language> for one not listed).
source.b.notesLangSet: Your voice notes to {chat} are now translated into {lang}.
source.b.notesLangCleared: Your voice notes to {chat} are no longer translated.
source.b.notesLangNeedTarget: First pick where your voice notes go (/notes), then their language.
